title: Physically grounded photography
when_to_use: When image generation or editing requires physically grounded photography.
method: Describe a plausible camera position, sensor/lens behavior, lighting direction, dynamic range and physical contact. Prioritize causal image formation over vague 8K hyperrealism.
verification: Technique candidate grounded in referenced materials; no live model-output QA. Requires real-result benchmark and explicit promotion.
